name: cc-mods
description: Custom Claude Code mods, plus vendored mods from anthropics/claude-code-playground and data-goblin/claude-code-filetree.

plugins.name: blast-radius
plugins.description: Holds risky shell commands and shows what they would change, with Proceed and Cancel buttons.

plugins.name: filetree
plugins.description: An IDE-style file tree in the side pane, with git status and a shimmer on files Claude reads, writes or commits.

plugins.name: replay-theater
plugins.description: Step through the file edits Claude made in the last turn, one diff at a time.

plugins.name: token-weather
plugins.description: A live forecast of the context window, drawn above the prompt.

plugins.name: work-band
plugins.description: A one-line band above the prompt: the superpowers stage or Claude's to-do progress, and how many subagents are running.
